paragraphs.source_en: The fuse of the Siege of Osaka was lit before dawn on the seventh day of the eleventh month in the nineteenth year of Keichō. The following day, Senhime moved into Lady Yodo's quarters.

units.source_en: The fuse of the Siege of Osaka was lit before dawn on the seventh day of the eleventh month in the nineteenth year of Keichō.
units.source_zh: 大坂之战的引线，于庆长十九年冬月初七凌晨被点燃。

units.source_en: The following day, Senhime moved into Lady Yodo's quarters.
units.source_zh: 次日，千姬移至淀夫人居处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大坂之战的引线，于庆长十九年冬月初七凌晨被点燃。次日，千姬移至淀夫人居处。

paragraphs.source_en: There is no need to dwell upon Osaka's preparations for war; everything was already in place.

units.source_en: There is no need to dwell upon Osaka's preparations for war; everything was already in place.
units.source_zh: 大坂战备诸事已毕，无须赘言。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大坂战备诸事已毕，无须赘言。

paragraphs.source_en: The commander-in-chief, Hideyori, held the main keep with three thousand men under the banner magistrate Kōri Shume-no-suke, the standard magistrate Tsugawa Sakon, and the captains of his guard, Hosokawa Sanuki-no-kami Yorihiro and Mori Kawachi-no-kami Mototaka. Plainly, no one expected them to take a direct part in the fighting.

units.source_en: The commander-in-chief, Hideyori, held the main keep with three thousand men under the banner magistrate Kōri Shume-no-suke, the standard magistrate Tsugawa Sakon, and the captains of his guard, Hosokawa Sanuki-no-kami Yorihiro and Mori Kawachi-no-kami Mototaka.
units.source_zh: 总大将秀赖率领旗奉行郡主马亮、马印奉行津川左近、侍卫头领细川赞岐守赖范和森河内守元隆，共三千人马据守本城。

units.source_en: Plainly, no one expected them to take a direct part in the fighting.
units.source_zh: 显然，无人认为他们会直接参与战事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 总大将秀赖率领旗奉行郡主马亮、马印奉行津川左近、侍卫头领细川赞岐守赖范和森河内守元隆，共三千人马据守本城。显然，无人认为他们会直接参与战事。

paragraphs.source_en: With the depths of winter close at hand and swimming no longer possible, Hideyori applied himself to riding practice at Okuhara Toyomasa's urging.

units.source_en: With the depths of winter close at hand and swimming no longer possible, Hideyori applied himself to riding practice at Okuhara Toyomasa's urging.
units.source_zh: 马上就要进入寒冬，游水已是不能，在奥原丰政的劝说下，秀赖努力练习骑马。

paragraphs.source_zh: 马上就要进入寒冬，游水已是不能，在奥原丰政的劝说下，秀赖努力练习骑马。

paragraphs.source_en: On the western side of the second enceinte, the barbican at the rear gate was held by one thousand men under Aoki Minbu-shōyū Kazushige, while fifteen hundred under Makishima Genba-no-jō Shigetoshi guarded the ground north of that gate; farther west, camps were held by one thousand men under Najima Minbu-shōyū Tadazumi, five thousand under Mōri Buzen-no-kami Katsunaga, and four thousand under Hayami Kai-no-kami Morihisa.

units.source_en: On the western side of the second enceinte, the barbican at the rear gate was held by one thousand men under Aoki Minbu-shōyū Kazushige, while fifteen hundred under Makishima Genba-no-jō Shigetoshi guarded the ground north of that gate;
units.source_zh: 二道城西侧，后门的瓮城由青木民部少辅一重率一千人把守，后门之北则有槙岛玄蕃允重利的一千五百人守卫；

units.source_en: farther west, camps were held by one thousand men under Najima Minbu-shōyū Tadazumi, five thousand under Mōri Buzen-no-kami Katsunaga, and four thousand under Hayami Kai-no-kami Morihisa.
units.source_zh: 再往西，则有名岛民部少辅忠纯的一千人、毛利丰前守胜永的五千人、速水甲斐守守久的四千人结营把守。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二道城西侧，后门的瓮城由青木民部少辅一重率一千人把守，后门之北则有槙岛玄蕃允重利的一千五百人守卫；再往西，则有名岛民部少辅忠纯的一千人、毛利丰前守胜永的五千人、速水甲斐守守久的四千人结营把守。

paragraphs.source_en: On the southern side, a combined force of thirteen thousand under Sengoku Buzen Nyūdō Sōya, Chōsokabe Kunai-shōyū Morichika, Akashi Kamon-no-suke Morishige, Yuasa Ukon Masatoshi, Ishikawa Higo-no-kami Yasukatsu, and others occupied the center. Near the Tamatsukuri Gate stood thirteen hundred men under Oda Nagayori, while five thousand under the army's de facto commander, Ōno Shuri-no-suke Harunaga, and three thousand under Gotō Matabei Mototsugu were deployed as mobile forces.

units.source_en: On the southern side, a combined force of thirteen thousand under Sengoku Buzen Nyūdō Sōya, Chōsokabe Kunai-shōyū Morichika, Akashi Kamon-no-suke Morishige, Yuasa Ukon Masatoshi, Ishikawa Higo-no-kami Yasukatsu, and others occupied the center. Near the Tamatsukuri Gate stood thirteen hundred men under Oda Nagayori, while five thousand under the army's de facto commander, Ōno Shuri-no-suke Harunaga, and three thousand under Gotō Matabei Mototsugu were deployed as mobile forces.
units.source_zh: 南侧，仙石丰前入道宗也、长曾我部宫内少辅盛亲、明石扫部助守重、汤浅右近正寿、石川肥后守康胜等合共一万三千人居中，靠近玉造口一带，则部署织田长赖的一千三百人，事实上的总大将大野修理亮治长的五千人和后藤又兵卫基次的三千人则被部署为机动部队。

paragraphs.source_zh: 南侧，仙石丰前入道宗也、长曾我部宫内少辅盛亲、明石扫部助守重、汤浅右近正寿、石川肥后守康胜等合共一万三千人居中，靠近玉造口一带，则部署织田长赖的一千三百人，事实上的总大将大野修理亮治长的五千人和后藤又兵卫基次的三千人则被部署为机动部队。

paragraphs.source_en: On the northern side, Ōno Shume-no-suke Harufusa's five thousand men occupied the northwestern corner, while Fujino Hanya's three thousand held the Kyōbashi Gate. The barbican was defended by three thousand men under Hotta Zusho-no-suke Katsuyoshi and others, and the Mariners' Gate by three thousand under Itō Tango-no-kami Nagazane... Osaka Castle was indeed defended on every side.

units.source_en: On the northern side, Ōno Shume-no-suke Harufusa's five thousand men occupied the northwestern corner, while Fujino Hanya's three thousand held the Kyōbashi Gate.
units.source_zh: 北侧，西北角上乃是大野主马亮治房的五千人，京桥口为藤野半弥的三千人。

units.source_en: The barbican was defended by three thousand men under Hotta Zusho-no-suke Katsuyoshi and others, and the Mariners' Gate by three thousand under Itō Tango-no-kami Nagazane... Osaka Castle was indeed defended on every side.
units.source_zh: 瓮城则由堀田图书助胜嘉等所率三千人守，水手口为伊东丹后守长实所率三千人……大坂城真可谓团团布防。

paragraphs.source_zh: 北侧，西北角上乃是大野主马亮治房的五千人，京桥口为藤野半弥的三千人。瓮城则由堀田图书助胜嘉等所率三千人守，水手口为伊东丹后守长实所率三千人……大坂城真可谓团团布防。

paragraphs.source_en: These dispositions formed the supposedly impregnable heart of Hideyori's main defenses, and the third enceinte was likewise assigned in detail. Southwest of the third enceinte lay a broad open space with several entrances, each connected to the streets of the town.

units.source_en: These dispositions formed the supposedly impregnable heart of Hideyori's main defenses, and the third enceinte was likewise assigned in detail.
units.source_zh: 这些部署构成了秀赖“固若金汤”的主阵核心，另，三道城也作了详尽部署。

units.source_en: Southwest of the third enceinte lay a broad open space with several entrances, each connected to the streets of the town.
units.source_zh: 三道城西南乃是一片开阔的空地，有若干个出入口，分别与街市相连。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这些部署构成了秀赖“固若金汤”的主阵核心，另，三道城也作了详尽部署。三道城西南乃是一片开阔的空地，有若干个出入口，分别与街市相连。

paragraphs.source_en: Although the number of people within the castle had now reached roughly one hundred thousand, there were far too few generals to command them. More than half the commanders assigned to the third enceinte also had to shoulder responsibility for the defenses of the second.

units.source_en: Although the number of people within the castle had now reached roughly one hundred thousand, there were far too few generals to command them.
units.source_zh: 城内的人此时虽已达到了十万左右，但统领他们的大将却远远不够。

units.source_en: More than half the commanders assigned to the third enceinte also had to shoulder responsibility for the defenses of the second.
units.source_zh: 部署于三道城的将领，半数以上不得不身兼二道城的防务。

paragraphs.source_zh: 城内的人此时虽已达到了十万左右，但统领他们的大将却远远不够。部署于三道城的将领，半数以上不得不身兼二道城的防务。

paragraphs.source_en: Not only the Ōno brothers but Aoki Kazushige, Mōri Katsunaga, Akashi Kamon, Yuasa Ukon, Sengoku Sōya, Chōsokabe Morichika, Kōri Shume, Kimura Shigenari, and others all had to command several units concurrently in the third enceinte.

units.source_en: Not only the Ōno brothers but Aoki Kazushige, Mōri Katsunaga, Akashi Kamon, Yuasa Ukon, Sengoku Sōya, Chōsokabe Morichika, Kōri Shume, Kimura Shigenari, and others all had to command several units concurrently in the third enceinte.
units.source_zh: 大野兄弟不消说，青木一重、毛利胜永、明石扫部、汤浅右近、仙石宗也、长曾我部盛亲、郡主马、木村重成等人，也都不得不在三道城身兼数队的统领任务。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大野兄弟不消说，青木一重、毛利胜永、明石扫部、汤浅右近、仙石宗也、长曾我部盛亲、郡主马、木村重成等人，也都不得不在三道城身兼数队的统领任务。

paragraphs.source_en: Moreover, to hold the third enceinte, a protective screen of fortifications had to be erected outside the castle. This was precisely what troubled Sanada Yukimura most. At a vital point south of the castle he built the Sanada fortification and stationed five thousand men there under his son Daisuke Yukitsuna and Iki Shichirōemon Tōo.

units.source_en: Moreover, to hold the third enceinte, a protective screen of fortifications had to be erected outside the castle.

ja.t: かなければならなかった。

units.source_zh: 而且，要想守住三道城，须在城外要塞构筑一道防护篱。

units.source_en: This was precisely what troubled Sanada Yukimura most.

ja.t: ませたのも、まさにこの

units.source_zh: 最让真田幸村苦恼的也就在此处。

units.source_en: At a vital point south of the castle he built the Sanada fortification and stationed five thousand men there under his son Daisuke Yukitsuna and Iki Shichirōemon Tōo.
units.source_zh: 他在城南一紧要处构筑了“真田护城”，令儿子大助幸纲与伊木七郎右卫门远雄率领五千人在此镇守。

paragraphs.source_zh: 而且，要想守住三道城，须在城外要塞构筑一道防护篱。最让真田幸村苦恼的也就在此处。他在城南一紧要处构筑了“真田护城”，令儿子大助幸纲与伊木七郎右卫门远雄率领五千人在此镇守。

paragraphs.source_en: The Gamō stockade northeast of the castle was held by three hundred men under Iida Sama-no-suke. The Imafuku stockade was garrisoned by three hundred under Yano Izumi-no-kami Masatomo. The Shigino stockade was held by two thousand men under Inoue Rōzaemon Yoritsugu and retainers of Ōno Harunaga. Harunaga could not possibly command at the Shigino stockade in person, however; he merely exercised oversight.

units.source_en: The Gamō stockade northeast of the castle was held by three hundred men under Iida Sama-no-suke.
units.source_zh: 城东北的蒲生栅栏，由饭田左马助率三百人把守。

units.source_en: The Imafuku stockade was garrisoned by three hundred under Yano Izumi-no-kami Masatomo.
units.source_zh: 今福栅栏由矢野和泉守正伦率三百人驻守。

units.source_en: The Shigino stockade was held by two thousand men under Inoue Rōzaemon Yoritsugu and retainers of Ōno Harunaga.
units.source_zh: 鴫野栅栏由井上郎左卫门赖次和大野治长的部下共两千人把守。

units.source_en: Harunaga could not possibly command at the Shigino stockade in person, however; he merely exercised oversight.
units.source_zh: 只是，治长实不可能到这鴫野栅栏指挥，只是监督而已。

paragraphs.source_zh: 城东北的蒲生栅栏，由饭田左马助率三百人把守。今福栅栏由矢野和泉守正伦率三百人驻守。鴫野栅栏由井上郎左卫门赖次和大野治长的部下共两千人把守。只是，治长实不可能到这鴫野栅栏指挥，只是监督而已。

paragraphs.source_en: The southwestern fort was defended by eight hundred men under Akashi Tango-no-kami Kanenobu. The fort at Bakurōbuchi was garrisoned by seven hundred men under Susukida Hayato-no-shō Kanesuke, Yonemura Rokubē, and Hirako Shuzen Sadamori. The fort at Senba was held by four hundred of Ōno Harunaga's men.

units.source_en: The southwestern fort was defended by eight hundred men under Akashi Tango-no-kami Kanenobu.
units.source_zh: 西南的城寨，则由明石丹后守金延的八百人守护。

units.source_en: The fort at Bakurōbuchi was garrisoned by seven hundred men under Susukida Hayato-no-shō Kanesuke, Yonemura Rokubē, and Hirako Shuzen Sadamori.
units.source_zh: 博劳渊的城寨由薄田隼人正兼相、米村六兵卫、平子主膳贞诠的七百人驻守。

units.source_en: The fort at Senba was held by four hundred of Ōno Harunaga's men.
units.source_zh: 船场的要塞为大野治长属下四百人把守。

paragraphs.source_zh: 西南的城寨，则由明石丹后守金延的八百人守护。博劳渊的城寨由薄田隼人正兼相、米村六兵卫、平子主膳贞诠的七百人驻守。船场的要塞为大野治长属下四百人把守。

paragraphs.source_en: The shipyard fort to the northwest was garrisoned by eight hundred men under Ōno Dōken. The Fukushima fort was defended by twenty-five hundred men under Ogura Sakuzaemon Yukiharu and Miyajima Bitchū-no-kami Kaneoki. At the Tenma fort stood ten thousand men under Oda Urakusai... Once every post had been assigned, the force of one hundred thousand was apportioned in the blink of an eye.

units.source_en: The shipyard fort to the northwest was garrisoned by eight hundred men under Ōno Dōken.
units.source_zh: 西北的船库要塞为大野道犬的八百人驻守。

units.source_en: The Fukushima fort was defended by twenty-five hundred men under Ogura Sakuzaemon Yukiharu and Miyajima Bitchū-no-kami Kaneoki.
units.source_zh: 福岛要塞则由小仓作左卫门行春和宫岛备中守兼兴的二千五百人守护。

units.source_en: At the Tenma fort stood ten thousand men under Oda Urakusai... Once every post had been assigned, the force of one hundred thousand was apportioned in the blink of an eye.
units.source_zh: 天满城寨有织田有乐斋的一万人……一一部署下来，十万之众眨眼间就分配完毕。

paragraphs.source_zh: 西北的船库要塞为大野道犬的八百人驻守。福岛要塞则由小仓作左卫门行春和宫岛备中守兼兴的二千五百人守护。天满城寨有织田有乐斋的一万人……一一部署下来，十万之众眨眼间就分配完毕。

paragraphs.source_en: Furthermore, because the commanders of the outlying forts also had to ensure the safety of the second enceinte, the hired men outside were effectively left to fight as they saw fit, responding to events on their own.

units.source_en: Furthermore, because the commanders of the outlying forts also had to ensure the safety of the second enceinte, the hired men outside were effectively left to fight as they saw fit, responding to events on their own.
units.source_zh: 而且，由于城外寨垒的指挥者必须同时负责二道城的安全，也就意味着，外面那些临时雇佣的人，只能照自己的意思随机作战了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 而且，由于城外寨垒的指挥者必须同时负责二道城的安全，也就意味着，外面那些临时雇佣的人，只能照自己的意思随机作战了。

paragraphs.source_en: But how did this entire series of supposedly impregnable dispositions appear to Tokugawa Ieyasu, who had ridden through armies by the thousands and had never yielded even to the late Taikō?

units.source_en: But how did this entire series of supposedly impregnable dispositions appear to Tokugawa Ieyasu, who had ridden through armies by the thousands and had never yielded even to the late Taikō?
units.source_zh: 这一系列“固若金汤”的部署，在曾经驰骋于千军万马、连对已故太阁都不曾服输的德川家康眼里，究竟怎样呢？

paragraphs.source_zh: 这一系列“固若金汤”的部署，在曾经驰骋于千军万马、连对已故太阁都不曾服输的德川家康眼里，究竟怎样呢？

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu gave Doi Toshikatsu a severe rebuke for proposing that Yamaguchi Shigemasa be sent into the castle to assassinate Hideyori. His reason for stopping it was plain: Hideyori was already a cornered beast making its last stand—how could they stoop to assassination?

units.source_en: Ieyasu gave Doi Toshikatsu a severe rebuke for proposing that Yamaguchi Shigemasa be sent into the castle to assassinate Hideyori.
units.source_zh: 家康将献计令山口重政入城暗杀秀赖的土井利胜训斥了一顿。

units.source_en: His reason for stopping it was plain: Hideyori was already a cornered beast making its last stand—how could they stoop to assassination?

ja.t: をしているのだ。どうして

units.source_zh: 他加以阻止，其用意已很明白：秀赖已是“困兽犹斗”，岂可干那暗刺的勾当？

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康将献计令山口重政入城暗杀秀赖的土井利胜训斥了一顿。他加以阻止，其用意已很明白：秀赖已是“困兽犹斗”，岂可干那暗刺的勾当？

paragraphs.source_en: On the fifth day of the eleventh month, Ieyasu summoned Katagiri Katsumoto to Nijō Castle and ordered him to attack Osaka. Then he immediately called for Jō Izumi-no-kami Nobushige and charged him with conveying an utterly contrary secret command to the Katō and Ikeda contingents already southwest of Osaka Castle: they were not to rush into an attack.

units.source_en: On the fifth day of the eleventh month, Ieyasu summoned Katagiri Katsumoto to Nijō Castle and ordered him to attack Osaka. Then he immediately called for Jō Izumi-no-kami Nobushige and charged him with conveying an utterly contrary secret command to the Katō and Ikeda contingents already southwest of Osaka Castle: they were not to rush into an attack.
units.source_zh: 冬月初五，家康把片桐且元传到二条城，命他进攻大坂，然后，立时将城和泉守信茂传来，令他向已进至大坂城西南的加藤、池田两部，传达一条完全相反的密令：不可急于进攻！

paragraphs.source_zh: 冬月初五，家康把片桐且元传到二条城，命他进攻大坂，然后，立时将城和泉守信茂传来，令他向已进至大坂城西南的加藤、池田两部，传达一条完全相反的密令：不可急于进攻！

paragraphs.source_en: Even as Ieyasu ordered Katagiri Katsumoto to attack Osaka, he secretly commanded Katō Shikibu-shōyū Akinari and the brothers Ikeda Musashi-no-kami Toshitaka and Ikeda Saemon-no-kami Tadatsugu, who had hurried forward to the Kanzaki River line: “This ground lies very close to Osaka Castle and the terrain is unfavorable. On no account are you to cross the river lightly. Continue to ascertain the enemy's movements and await orders where you are.”

units.source_en: Even as Ieyasu ordered Katagiri Katsumoto to attack Osaka, he secretly commanded Katō Shikibu-shōyū Akinari and the brothers Ikeda Musashi-no-kami Toshitaka and Ikeda Saemon-no-kami Tadatsugu, who had hurried forward to the Kanzaki River line: “This ground lies very close to Osaka Castle and the terrain is unfavorable. On no account are you to cross the river lightly.
units.source_zh: 家康一面命令片桐且元进攻大坂，另一面却对匆匆进至神崎川一线的加藤式部少辅明成和池田武藏守利隆、池田左卫门督忠继兄弟传下密令：“此地距大坂城甚近，地势不佳，绝不可轻易渡河。

units.source_en: Continue to ascertain the enemy's movements and await orders where you are.”
